kappa_note: inherited verbatim from gmi-833-g0-grammar-growth-v1 (#897), which derives kappa=1 by its frozen grid rule; not re-derived here

rep3.selection_rule: c-padded word over {a,b,c} of the registered length containing exactly one greedy non-overlapping occurrence of 'ab', placed after the registered prefix of 'c'; chosen by rule before any burden was computed

capital_boundary.library_rule: single macro whose body is the whole target word w* over the base alphabet
capital_boundary.requirement: REP-1 band on w* must be GUARANTEED_REDUCTION; REP-2 must reject L_sol on the registered distribution

no_reuse_hostile.requirement: Saving(T+) == 0 and dNet > 0 strictly on the registered distribution

nov2.requirement: ADDED(B) and REMOVED(B) both nonempty for at least one registered B; exact counts reported at every B

sd_frame.budget_rule: B_eval = 3**ell (one full sweep's worth of evaluations)
sd_frame.target_word_rule: the lexicographically-median word of Sigma^ell under a<b<c, i.e. index (3**ell - 1)//2
sd_frame.decoy_word_rule: position-wise successor of the target modulo the base alphabet order, giving Hamming distance exactly ell
sd_frame.ls_restart: restart from a fresh seeded uniform point on reaching a strict local optimum

two_sided_requirement.GRADED: guided dynamics must beat the RAND control
two_sided_requirement.OPAQUE: guided dynamics must NOT beat the RAND control

no_alarm_obligation: the frame validator and the REP-1 band classifier must be asserted SILENT on every clean registered instance; a checker that fires on clean data is a defect
